name: summable_mul_of_summable_norm'
statement: ι → R} {g : ι' → R} (hf : Summable fun x => ‖f x‖) (h'f : Summable f) (hg : Summable fun x => ‖g x‖) (h'g : Summable g) : Summable fun x : ι × ι' => f x.1 * g x.2

name: summable_norm_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm
statement: ℕ → R} (hf : Summable fun x => ‖f x‖) (hg : Summable fun x => ‖g x‖) : Summable fun n => ‖∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal n, f kl.1 * g kl.2‖
